title: Shimmer Lip Gloss & Cream Highlighter Duo Gift Set
descriptionHtml:
✓ Natural Finish
What it is: A set with a cream shimmer and shimmer lip gloss.

Ingredient Callouts. These products are also vegan and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: The shimmer duo set includes a Cream Shimmer and Shimmer Lip Gloss in Solstice. Inspired by the bestselling Chrome collection, Solstice is a universally flattering Bronze Shimmer that delivers a subtle glow to full iridescence shimmer effect.

This Set Contains:
- 0.05 oz/ 1.5 mL Cream Shimmer
- 0.44 mL/ 13 mL Shimmer Lip Gloss
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Lightly tap Cream Shimmer onto the high points of the face using your fingertips.
-Layer over cream blush or apply to the eyes for a multidimensional glow.
-Squeeze a small amount of lip gloss and glide over the lips for an elevated, high-shine finish. -Wear alone or layer over Lip Sculpt (sold separately).
Ingredients+
Cream Shimmer:
Octyldodecanol, Silica, Calcium Aluminum Borosilicate, Cera Microcristallina (Microcrystalline Wax), Synthetic Beeswax, Bis-Diglyceryl Polyacyladipate-2, Silica Dimethyl Silylate, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Mica, Phenoxyethanol, Tin Oxide, Caprylyl Glycol, Iron Oxides (CI 77491), Ferric Ferrocyanide (CI 77510), Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891).

Shimmer Lip Gloss:
Polyisobutene, Tridecyl Trimellitate, Octyldodecanol, Hydrogenated Microcrystalline Cera (Hydrogenated Microcrystalline Wax), Silica Dimethyl Silylate, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Tocopheryl Acetate, Phenoxyethanol, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Calcium Aluminum Borosilicate, Caprylyl Glycol, Limnanthes Alba (Meadowfoam) Seed Oil, Glyceryl Behenate, Sodium Hyaluronate, Tin Oxide [+/- May Contain/Peut Contenir: Blue 1 Lake (CI 42090), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499), Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891)].
